ALWAYS ADVANCING THE STANDARD
Innovation is a word that automakers toss around like there’s no
tomorrow. But unless a car is truly groundbreaking, it’s merely new,
and tomorrow’s just another day. For five generations, the C‑Class
has pioneered breakthroughs in performance, safety and luxury. It’s
raised the standards of what drivers expect from a car — not just in
its class, but at any price. And yet, year after year, the C‑Class puts
far‑reaching innovation within reach. For 2016, tomorrow comes
with three new power choices,1 added safety and fresh technology.
Does change start with C? If you mean the C‑Class, of course.

FOR THE BEST OF TIMES
The wide, cascading console and thick, Nappa
leather‑trimmed steering wheel greet you with a
singular message: Every element of the C‑Class
cockpit is designed and crafted to elevate your
driving enjoyment. Instruments and displays are
vivid, clear and set to your sight lines. Controls
feel natural in your hands, from the shift paddles
to the console touchpad. And every choice in
materials looks and feels just right — from sleek
aluminum, to satin and gloss woods, to the
precise topstitching of the seats, doors and
dash. It takes extra time to finish a car this way,
but you’ll savor the results for years to come.
FOR THE TEST OF TIME
A C‑Class lets you select from an extraordinary
palette of colors, materials and styles for your
cabin appointments. But it does not make you
choose between immediate gratification and
enduring comfort. The standard 10‑way power
front seats help you find your perfect seating
position. The 3‑position driver‑seat memory
makes it easy to find it again. Even your lumbar
support power‑adjusts four ways. The available
heated and ventilated front seats — as well as
the new option of a heated steering wheel —
offer rapid yet lasting comfort as the seasons
change. And while you can’t see the materials
beneath the stylish surfaces, they’re chosen to
make you feel at ease in other important ways.
Steam‑expanded foams — a process pioneered
by Mercedes‑Benz — eliminate harsh chemicals,
while products from flax, coconut and olives
sustainably support numerous cabin elements.

GASOLINE TURBOS AND BITURBOS
The Direct Injection gasoline engines of the C‑Class span
from a turbo‑4 that delivers brisk acceleration and up to
34 highway mpg,3 to an AMG‑enhanced 362‑hp biturbo V‑6,
to handcrafted biturbo AMG V‑8s with 469 or 503 hp. All
feature multispark ignition that can rapidly fire each spark
plug several times in a millisecond, to get the most power
from every drop of gasoline. And when idling in traffic or at
a stoplight, their ECO Start/Stop system can automatically
pause the engine — using no fuel and creating no emissions.
When you’re ready to go, the engine restarts instantly.
NEW TURBOCHARGED CLEAN DIESEL
Mercedes‑Benz pioneered BlueTEC® technology to reinvent
the diesel engine. Smooth, quiet, and with certified ultralow
emissions in all 50 states, the new C 300d1 generates more
torque from a turbo‑4 than many gasoline V‑8s: 369 lb‑ft at
just 1,600 rpm. Its strong, seamless acceleration comes with
the bonuses of exceptional fuel economy and driving range.3
FIRST PLUG-IN HYBRID C-CLASS
The new C 350e1 is more than just a new era in eco‑friendly
luxury and performance. Its 4‑mode HYBRID drive is among
the most intelligent, efficient gas‑electric powertrains on the
road, optimizing the use of its gasoline turbo‑4 and electric
motor to traffic, terrain and even route‑map data while using
the navigation system. Around town, you can drive short
distances on electricity alone, creating no local emissions.4
On longer trips, it can keep its advanced lithium‑ion battery
charged while you’re on the open road — saving it up to allow
all‑electric city driving later on. Gas and electric power can
also team up to boost acceleration. And while the gasoline
engine and regenerative braking system help replenish the
battery as you drive, it’s a Plug‑In HYBRID — so you can also
recharge it at home or at most any public charging station.5
Please see endnotes at back of brochure.

EVERY GOOD TURN DESERVES ANOTHER
Accelerating from 0 to 60 is a great way to enjoy a car’s power for
a few seconds. With the right road, you can savor a C‑Class Sedan’s
crisp handling for hours. And with its silky ride, there’s rarely a wrong
road. A precise 4‑wheel multilink suspension underpins every C‑Class.
Depending on model, you can also add sport or comfort tuning of its
road‑sensing AGILITY CONTROL®, or self‑leveling, multimode AIRMATIC.®
The AMG models go even further with their own hardware and tuning.
So whether you’re aiming to carve up a canyon, iron out a city street,
or tame a track, there’s a C‑Class that fits you like a driving glove.

DRIVE LIFE TO THE FULLEST
Driving is all about responding to change. Even in
your daily commute, every mile can be different.
So can each day — as weather, passengers and
road conditions come and go. No matter where
you’re going, you can adapt how your C‑Class
feels and responds to how you feel. A few taps of
its DYNAMIC SELECT button can dial up sharper
handling, relaxed comfort, or peak efficiency. You
can even create a mode all your own. It’s one of
many vehicle settings you can customize via the
car’s touchpad and big color screen. The touchpad
also puts a world of entertainment and information
at your fingertips, with tablet‑style gestures like
swipe and pinch‑to‑zoom, or even handwriting.
And since your soundtrack can change a good
drive to great, Burmester®— Germany’s renowned
crafter of high‑end home audio — has developed a
590‑watt, 9‑channel surround sound system with
13 high‑end speakers and exquisite metal grilles.

FOR THE BEST OF TIMES
The wide, cascading console and thick, Nappa
leather‑trimmed steering wheel greet you with a
singular message: Every element of the C‑Class
cockpit is designed and crafted to elevate your
driving enjoyment. Instruments and displays are
vivid, clear and set to your sight lines. Controls
feel natural in your hands, from the shift paddles
to the console touchpad. And every choice in
materials looks and feels just right — from sleek
aluminum, to satin and gloss woods, to the
precise topstitching of the seats, doors and
dash. It takes extra time to finish a car this way,
but you’ll savor the results for years to come.
FOR THE TEST OF TIME
A C‑Class lets you select from an extraordinary
palette of colors, materials and styles for your
cabin appointments. But it does not make you
choose between immediate gratification and
enduring comfort. The standard 10‑way power
front seats help you find your perfect seating
position. The 3‑position driver‑seat memory
makes it easy to find it again. Even your lumbar
support power‑adjusts four ways. The available
heated and ventilated front seats — as well as
the new option of a heated steering wheel —
offer rapid yet lasting comfort as the seasons
change. And while you can’t see the materials
beneath the stylish surfaces, they’re chosen to
make you feel at ease in other important ways.
Steam‑expanded foams — a process pioneered
by Mercedes‑Benz — eliminate harsh chemicals,
while products from flax, coconut and olives
sustainably support numerous cabin elements.
